name: video
description: Areca Pulse videos rendered from code with Remotion (daily rates shorts for YouTube, Instagram and WhatsApp).

scripts.gif: npm run data && remotion render src/index.ts Promo out/areca-pulse-promo.gif --codec=gif --every-nth-frame=3 --scale=0.5
scripts.render:intro: remotion render src/index.ts BrandIntro out/brand-intro.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:snapshot: remotion render src/index.ts DailyRates out/daily-rates-kn.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --props=./snapshot-props.json && remotion render src/index.ts DailyRates out/daily-rates-en.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --props=./snapshot-props-en.json
scripts.voice:check: python3 -m venv voice/.venv && voice/.venv/bin/pip install -q -r voice/requirements.txt && voice/.venv/bin/python voice/tts.py --check
scripts.encourage: remotion render src/index.ts Encourage out/keep-going.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
